name: gh
description: GitHub and git workflow skills. /gh:sync moves a checkout to its default branch, fast-forwards it, and prunes branches whose work has already landed. /gh:shepherd merges a repo's auto-merge-enabled dependencies PRs one at a time, rebasing and waiting on CI, and skips anything that needs a logic change. gh:issues files, links and triages issues with duplicate checks, relationship fields, milestone, type and priority.
